description:
For the third year in a row, Harry Kane has crowned himself Bundesliga's top scorer, scoring 36 goals in 32 appearances. By scoring these goals, he is also on pace to win the European golden boot. Individually, this was the fifth best goal scoring performance in Bundesliga history, only behind Robert Lewandowski (2020/21), Gerd Müller (1969/70 & 1971/72) and himself in 2023/24. 
Enjoy the best of all 36 goals!
